entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My motorcade traveled for over an h..."
entries.dialogueText: My motorcade traveled for over an hour before the Archsanctuary of Plavo appeared on the horizon. Its golden dome radiated under the sunrise.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a view I’d seen countless ti..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a view I’d seen countless times, but it never failed to inspire awe.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a view that inspired awe in..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a view that inspired awe in many a Rizian, especially the most devout followers of St. Wruhec.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, who was sitting next to the..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, who was sitting next to the driver, turned back to me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We shall be arriving shortly, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall be arriving shortly, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I’ve been looking forward to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I’ve been looking forward to this for quite some time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let’s get this over with.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let’s get this over with."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This should be interesting.""
entries.dialogueText: "This should be interesting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was here for the Consecration of..."
entries.dialogueText: I was here for the Consecration of the King, the centuries-old ecclesiastical ceremony symbolizing a monarch's appointment as God’s highest representative on earth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Better known as the “divine right o..."
entries.dialogueText: Better known as the “divine right of kings.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Unlike my coronation, this was a pr..."
entries.dialogueText: Unlike my coronation, this was a private event shrouded in secrecy.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Not even my father, despite my aski..."
entries.dialogueText: Not even my father, despite my asking, would disclose what occurred. He'd simply say, “What took place was between me and God.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But aside from the pomp and circums..."
entries.dialogueText: But aside from the pomp and circumstance of the Consecration of the King, this meeting was my chance to catch up on Rizia's current state of religious affairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, my car pulled up in fr..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, my car pulled up in front of the towering colonnades situated on either side of the entrance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Grand Wiseman Ignacius... looking..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius... looking as stoic as ever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at the old geezer. Hard to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at the old geezer. Hard to believe he's still breathing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here we go.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here we go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While most shouted my praises, ther..."
entries.dialogueText: While most shouted my praises, there was a small group of demonstrators protesting against the ceremony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A welcoming smile spread across the..."
entries.dialogueText: A welcoming smile spread across the Grand Wiseman's face as he came down the stairs.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Welcome, Your Majesty. We are grea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Welcome, Your Majesty. We are greatly honored to have you here for this momentous occasion."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I look forward to serving you just..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to serving you just as I served your father.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is I who is honored to be here.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is I who is honored to be here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall honor this day with the di..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall honor this day with the dignity and respect this sacred tradition deserves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I could think of better ways to sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could think of better ways to spend my day. But when duty calls, one must oblige."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“It fills my heart with joy to hear..."
entries.dialogueText: “It fills my heart with joy to hear it.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I shall do my best to provide you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall do my best to provide you with both personal and state guidance on religion.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Thank you, Grand Wiseman. I aspire..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Grand Wiseman. I aspire to fulfill God's will here on earth, just as you have done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Time is short, Grand Wiseman. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: “Time is short, Grand Wiseman. Let us skip the pleasantries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I am privileged to receive you..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am privileged to receive your guidance.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your best? Only the weak whine abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your best? Only the weak whine about doing their best."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I'm merely a humble servant, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm merely a humble servant, Your Grace. I do as God commands."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“The six stars of St. Wruhec still..."
entries.dialogueText: “The six stars of St. Wruhec still shine upon our nation."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Come, let us step inside. We have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Come, let us step inside. We have much to discuss.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We began heading toward the entranc..."
entries.dialogueText: We began heading toward the entrance. However, I didn't get very far before my attention was drawn to a commotion from behind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I turned to look, a throng of pe..."
entries.dialogueText: As I turned to look, a throng of people surged against my security guards.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't want to be seen as a cowar..."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't want to be seen as a coward, so I stood my ground as the man approached.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I hurried towards the archsanctuary..."
entries.dialogueText: I hurried towards the archsanctuary before he could reach me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus, without missing a beat, caug..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus, without missing a beat, caught the man by the arm and threw him to the ground. Other guards approached as Titus held him down.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's so blasphemous about Golcon..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's so blasphemous about Golcondism?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“And so you banned them. Rightly so..."
entries.dialogueText: “And so you banned them. Rightly so, I might add."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Could we not have built Golcondist..."
entries.dialogueText: “Could we not have built Golcondist sanctuaries to pacify them?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a nod from Captain Gordion, tw..."
entries.dialogueText: With a nod from Captain Gordion, two of his guardsmen lifted the man to his feet and escorted him away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal and I continued towards the arc..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal and I continued towards the archsanctuary's entrance.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I humbly apologize for the interru..."
entries.dialogueText: "I humbly apologize for the interruption, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Shall we proceed?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Shall we proceed?”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Lead the way.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lead the way.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Yes. The sooner we get this over w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. The sooner we get this over with, the better.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“How could I say no?""
entries.dialogueText: “How could I say no?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just point me in the right directi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just point me in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I accompanied Sal into the archsanc..."
entries.dialogueText: I accompanied Sal into the archsanctuary. Titus and one of his men stood guard at the entrance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our footsteps echoed throughout the..."
entries.dialogueText: Our footsteps echoed throughout the massive empty chamber as we made our way down the main aisle that separated the hall in two.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was surrounded by ornate wall mur..."
entries.dialogueText: I was surrounded by ornate wall murals of religious scene depictions, leaving no surface bare. Nearby statues seemed to watch me as I passed.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“It’s only fitting that such a monu..."
entries.dialogueText: “It’s only fitting that such a monument be built atop the final resting place of Rizia's most revered disciple."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“This place never fails to impress...."
entries.dialogueText: “This place never fails to impress.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I remember the archsanctuary being..."
entries.dialogueText: “I remember the archsanctuary being a lot bigger.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“One could get lost in a place like..."
entries.dialogueText: “One could get lost in a place like this.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“All spectacle. No sustenance.”"
entries.dialogueText: “All spectacle. No sustenance.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Some might say that spiritual sust..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some might say that spiritual sustenance comes from within."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Caelus the Devout. Singlehandedly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Caelus the Devout. Singlehandedly credited for spreading the teachings of St. Wruhec throughout our part of the world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I’m not here for a history lesson...."
entries.dialogueText: “I’m not here for a history lesson. Let’s get down to business.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a great admirer of his, I've al..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a great admirer of his, I've always aspired to lead a life of devotion and virtue, much like his own."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""If you insist.""
entries.dialogueText: "If you insist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Yes, yes. I know all about him. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, yes. I know all about him. But he’s not the reason why I’m here.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It warms my heart to hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "It warms my heart to hear it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Without him, we Rizians would be n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Without him, we Rizians would be no more enlightened than Dastnurists."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stopped when we'd reached the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: We stopped when we'd reached the chancel where the altar stood.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as you are Grand Wiseman,..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you are Grand Wiseman, I'm sure those values will persevere."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Dastnurists are particularly c..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Dastnurists are particularly concerning. Their religion disregards the centuries of progress since Descension Day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Golcondists pose a particularl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golcondists pose a particularly large threat, using Wruhecism as a cover for blasphemy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't call it 'diluted.' Supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't call it 'diluted.' Supporting a plurality of religions will only enrich Rizian culture."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But we must not lose sight of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we must not lose sight of our one true faith."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""However, he was also deluged with..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, he was also deluged with requests from the Dastnurist community. In particular, the Grandsanctuary of Sallabes has long been too small to serve worshippers' needs and is urgently in need of expansion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Why is it the government's respons..."
entries.dialogueText: “Why is it the government's responsibility to fund sanctuaries? Couldn't Rizia's religious congregations pay for their own repairs and expansions?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why didn't he just fund both proje..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why didn't he just fund both projects?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will begin the restoration of P..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will begin the restoration of Plavo at once."
entries.menuText: "We will begin the restoration of Plavo at once." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Both projects are equally importan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Both projects are equally important in my eyes. I will speak to Elena about funding both the Plavo restoration and the Sallabes Grandsanctuary expansion.”
entries.menuText: "Both projects are equally important in my eyes. I will speak to Elena about funding both the Plavo restoration and the Sallabes Grandsanctuary expansion.” [-4 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Serving the Dastnurist community s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serving the Dastnurist community should take priority at this time. I will grant the Archpriest of Sallabes' request."
entries.menuText: "Serving the Dastnurist community should take priority at this time. I will grant the Archpriest of Sallabes' request." [-2 Budget]

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“I see the wisdom in your decision...."
entries.dialogueText: “I see the wisdom in your decision. May God’s shining light forever guide you even through the darkest times.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Grand Wiseman nodded solemnly."
entries.dialogueText: The Grand Wiseman nodded solemnly.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Nur be praised!""
entries.dialogueText: "Nur be praised!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The holy man let out a small gasp."
entries.dialogueText: The holy man let out a small gasp.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal spread his arms wide open."
entries.dialogueText: Sal spread his arms wide open.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“With great honor, I shall lead you..."
entries.dialogueText: “With great honor, I shall lead you as you step across the threshold and unite with the divine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He motioned toward a stone archway..."
entries.dialogueText: He motioned toward a stone archway leading out of the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I followed the Grand Wiseman down a..."
entries.dialogueText: I followed the Grand Wiseman down a long corridor.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This way, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "This way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I continued after him as we went do..."
entries.dialogueText: I continued after him as we went down the stairs, which seemed to go on forever.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, we'd reached the botto..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, we'd reached the bottom, where I was greeted by a wall of human bones that were carefully stacked from top to bottom.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I had no idea this was down here.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I had no idea this was down here.”

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Most don’t.""
entries.dialogueText: "Most don’t."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As for the tomb's tenants, they're..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for the tomb's tenants, they're mostly wealthy noblemen and their families alongside other well-to-do individuals throughout the centuries."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This way, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "This way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we made our way down the tunnel,..."
entries.dialogueText: As we made our way down the tunnel, the ceiling began to close in around us, and feelings of claustrophobia began to sink in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just when it seemed like the tunnel..."
entries.dialogueText: Just when it seemed like the tunnel would never end, we emerged into a vast cavern, also illuminated by torchlight. Several wiscerers, lesser in rank than Sal, were waiting for us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were arranged around a marble..."
entries.dialogueText: They were arranged around a marble sarcophagus.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Is that who I think it is?""
entries.dialogueText: “Is that who I think it is?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Rare are those who have set foot h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rare are those who have set foot here. Count yourself among the blessed few."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Caelus the Devout's effigy became m..."
entries.dialogueText: Caelus the Devout's effigy became more apparent as I approached.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal placed his torch into a nearby..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal placed his torch into a nearby sconce as one of the other wisemen, carrying a silver tray, approached us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On it was a golden chalice, a clay..."
entries.dialogueText: On it was a golden chalice, a clay jug filled with oil, a sponge, and what appeared to be a bottle of wine.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Let us begin. Please remove your c..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let us begin. Please remove your clothes and stand on the royal seal.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I am ready.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am ready.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever you say.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Actually... I'm beginning to have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Actually... I'm beginning to have second thoughts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Following the Grand Wiseman's instr..."
entries.dialogueText: Following the Grand Wiseman's instructions, I joined him in reciting verses from the sacred scripture.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When my garments were completely re..."
entries.dialogueText: When my garments were completely removed, Sal proceeded to anoint me, dipping a sponge into the fragrant oil and gently applying it all over my body.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He then poured the wine into the ch..."
entries.dialogueText: He then poured the wine into the chalice until it reached the brim.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“It is well known that this is the..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is well known that this is the final resting place of Caelus the Devout."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But what most don’t know is that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "But what most don’t know is that this is where he performed his first miracle.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Miracle? Did I hear you correctly?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Miracle? Did I hear you correctly?”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I’ve never heard of disciples perf..."
entries.dialogueText: “I’ve never heard of disciples performing miracles before.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“I have gone along with you thus fa..."
entries.dialogueText: “I have gone along with you thus far. But are you really saying something supernatural happened here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Even as a religious man, I have tr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Even as a religious man, I have trouble believing in miracles."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: "“Yes. The miracle of foresight.""
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. The miracle of foresight."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""For upon filling his stomach with..."
entries.dialogueText: "For upon filling his stomach with the sacred wine -- the very wine before you now -- he was given the ability to prophesy the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What can I expect to see?""
entries.dialogueText: "What can I expect to see?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He poured the wine into the chalice..."
entries.dialogueText: He poured the wine into the chalice and held it high.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""You will see nothing. Only the mos..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will see nothing. Only the most pious and reverent men may drink from the sacred chalice."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""You see, once this wine is consume..."
entries.dialogueText: "You see, once this wine is consumed, Caelus the Devout's gift of foresight shall, for a time, be bestowed upon the person who ingests it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held up the chalice, once more,..."
entries.dialogueText: He held up the chalice, once more, and drank until the wine was gone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Setting it back down on the tray, h..."
entries.dialogueText: Setting it back down on the tray, he then stepped toward me and held out his hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We stood there in silence for what..."
entries.dialogueText: We stood there in silence for what felt like an eternity. I wasn't sure what to expect.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But then suddenly, his body began t..."
entries.dialogueText: But then suddenly, his body began to tremble and his hands took a firm grip in mine.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Listen closely to my words. For th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen closely to my words. For the gift of sight comes in flashes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I closed my eyes as well."
entries.dialogueText: I closed my eyes as well.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept my eyes open, waiting to see..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes open, waiting to see what would happen next.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Scanning the room, I watched as the..."
entries.dialogueText: Scanning the room, I watched as the other priests looked on, waiting to see what would happen next.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I placed my hands in his."
entries.dialogueText: I placed my hands in his.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took a step back."
entries.dialogueText: I took a step back.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pulled my hands away from him."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled my hands away from him.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""To consummate the Consecration of..."
entries.dialogueText: "To consummate the Consecration of the King I must insist that you take my hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, then."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nobody told me there would be prop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody told me there would be prophecies. I cannot govern with the burden of future events looming over me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And *I* must insist you remember w..."
entries.dialogueText: "And *I* must insist you remember who you're speaking to!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I must insist that you take my han..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must insist that you take my hand, or else I cannot bestow my consent on the ceremony's completion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I quickly put on my clothes and mad..."
entries.dialogueText: I quickly put on my clothes and made my way back through the catacombs until I'd reached the surface.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus and another guardsman were at..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus and another guardsman were at my side the moment they saw me re-emerge.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, is everything alrigh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, is everything alright?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's none of your concern. We're..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's none of your concern. We're leaving."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. We just have to go.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We just have to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I barreled past him without saying..."
entries.dialogueText: I barreled past him without saying a word.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get out of my way, Captain. Do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get out of my way, Captain. Do you want to be demoted to private?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought about the Grand Wiseman's..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about the Grand Wiseman's last words to me as the Archsanctuary of Plavo faded from view.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, my motorcade was back..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, my motorcade was back on the road.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By the time I'd made it back to the..."
entries.dialogueText: By the time I'd made it back to the car, the captain was so far behind, I ended up opening the door myself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I barely noticed when the motorcade..."
entries.dialogueText: I barely noticed when the motorcade pulled out of the city and back onto the highway.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I couldn't let go even if I wanted."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't let go even if I wanted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My outburst left the wiseman speech..."
entries.dialogueText: My outburst left the wiseman speechless. Seemingly shocked, he bowed his head and backed away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At his advanced age, he wasn't exac..."
entries.dialogueText: At his advanced age, he wasn't exactly spry.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Are you alright, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you alright, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I should be the one asking you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I should be the one asking you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's none of your concern.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's none of your concern."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As best as one can be, given the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "As best as one can be, given the situation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm fine. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm fine. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Very well, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well, then."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I hope I'm not overstepping my bou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope I'm not overstepping my bounds. But it was a situation that, unfortunately, should never have happened in the first place--"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Can't say the same for myself. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't say the same for myself. These old bones don't move as quickly as they used to."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Oh, I may have some years on me, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I may have some years on me, but I'm not dead yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll be the judge of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He closed his eyes and began taking..."
entries.dialogueText: He closed his eyes and began taking in long deep breaths.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I see a crown. It's ascending into..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see a crown. It's ascending into the sky... rising high above the surrounding countryside--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know this may seem highly unorth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know this may seem highly unorthodox, but this whole secret ceremony just doesn't sit well with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must break with the archaic cust..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must break with the archaic customs of my predecessors if I am to be the ruler Rizia needs right now."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""A sovereign leader of this great n..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sovereign leader of this great nation you’re duty-bound to uphold this sacred tradition, just as all the monarchs who came before you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The crown you wear isn't just a de..."
entries.dialogueText: "The crown you wear isn't just a decorative headdress, but a symbol of national identity -- of unity and pride."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It represents stability and steadf..."
entries.dialogueText: "It represents stability and steadfast continuity even through the darkest of times."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""My point is that you not only embo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My point is that you not only embody a kingdom on earth, but the kingdom above."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does this diatribe have anyth..."
entries.dialogueText: "What does this diatribe have anything to do with my taking part in the ceremony?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm well aware of what the crown r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well aware of what the crown represents. Please get to the point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, and I am grateful for the res..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, and I am grateful for the responsibility bestowed upon me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I refrained from speaking to hear h..."
entries.dialogueText: I refrained from speaking to hear him out.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Everything."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""You not only embody a kingdom on e..."
entries.dialogueText: "You not only embody a kingdom on earth, but the kingdom above."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""What I'm trying to say is...""
entries.dialogueText: "What I'm trying to say is..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And I, for one, am grateful for ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I, for one, am grateful for having you as our king. As are the millions of subjects under your rule."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""For to reject the sacrament is to..."
entries.dialogueText: "For to reject the sacrament is to reject God himself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By that logic, a challenge to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By that logic, a challenge to your King is a challenge to the Almighty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. Please forgive me. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Please forgive me. The crown's weight is heavy, and only with God's guidance can I fulfill my duties."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Religion's place in society is wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Religion's place in society is without question. But as for its role in government... I have reservations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you finished?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you finished?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The wiscerer went silent. Though he..."
entries.dialogueText: The wiscerer went silent. Though he outwardly remained calm, the disdain in his eyes told a different story.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad you brought this to my at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you brought this to my attention, but I'd rather not make an immediate decision. I'll think it over once I'm back at the Palace."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""With all due respect to the Golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect to the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Wruhecism and the Rizian monarchy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhecism and the Rizian monarchy are one and the same. It has been that way since the beginning."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""This kingdom has been blessed for..."
entries.dialogueText: "This kingdom has been blessed for a reason. Any change to the status quo will surely jeopardize our prosperity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You make a valid point. I'm still..."
entries.dialogueText: "You make a valid point. I'm still not fully sold on religion's role in government, however, I know better than to upset that delicate balance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Religion and state should be separ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Religion and state should be separate. End of story."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe my position on this issu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe my position on this issue is unlikely to change. But I see no obstacle to finding common ground if the opportunity arises."

entries.dialogueText: "As long as similar... *arrangements* can be made in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No promises, but my door is always..."
entries.dialogueText: "No promises, but my door is always open to further discussions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "This was a one-time agreement. Be grateful you got any concessions at all."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Excellent. I look forward to a pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. I look forward to a prosperous relationship in the future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wished Wiseman Ignacius goodbye a..."
entries.dialogueText: I wished Wiseman Ignacius goodbye and left the premises. Captain Gordion and his men followed behind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As my motorcade traveled down the h..."
entries.dialogueText: As my motorcade traveled down the highway, and the Archsacturary of Plavo faded from view, I reflected on all I had accomplished today.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And hoped my future relationship wi..."
entries.dialogueText: And hoped my future relationship with the wiscerer would remain amicable.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Very well then. I will, of course,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well then. I will, of course, remain hopeful that you'll have a change of heart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I bid Wiseman Ignacius farewell and..."
entries.dialogueText: I bid Wiseman Ignacius farewell and departed the premises, with Captain Gordion and his men following closely behind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As my motorcade journeyed down the..."
entries.dialogueText: As my motorcade journeyed down the highway, the Archsacturary of Plavo slowly disappearing from sight, I reflected on all I had achieved today.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The wiscerer knew his place now. I..."
entries.dialogueText: The wiscerer knew his place now. I just hoped he wouldn't need friendly *reminders* in the future.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Then please, let us proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then please, let us proceed."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""If I may give you a piece of advic..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may give you a piece of advice..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may not. Good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may not. Good day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. But hurry it up. I haven't g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. But hurry it up. I haven't got all day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go ahead.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The throne you have inherited best..."
entries.dialogueText: "The throne you have inherited bestows great advantages, yet it also brings forth numerous adversities."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It would be a shame if any unneces..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be a shame if any unnecessary strains or hostilities were added to your troubles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that a threat?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that a threat?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I may give *you* a piece of..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I may give *you* a piece of advice... the door swings both ways."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You forget your place, Grand Wisem..."
entries.dialogueText: "You forget your place, Grand Wiseman. The onus lies not on the king to seek favor with others, but rather, it is others who should seek favor with the king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duly noted. I will take my leave...."
entries.dialogueText: "Duly noted. I will take my leave. Good day."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Heavens no! I'm simply saying... t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heavens no! I'm simply saying... tread carefully."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. Let's proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. Let's proceed."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Well, in any case, I'm glad you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, in any case, I'm glad you're here."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Don't let my physical frailty fool..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't let my physical frailty fool you, Your Majesty. For the grace of God gives me unimaginable strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. That's what I like to hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. That's what I like to hear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As he does with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "As he does with me."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""With pleasure.""
entries.dialogueText: "With pleasure."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""What?! But my king, you must.""
entries.dialogueText: "What?! But my king, you must."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. No, I don't.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. No, I don't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My most sincere apologies.""
entries.dialogueText: "My most sincere apologies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I mean no offense.""
entries.dialogueText: "I mean no offense."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going to repeat myself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to repeat myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, but I can't. This is to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, but I can't. This is too much."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And on the crown is a fracture on..."
entries.dialogueText: "And on the crown is a fracture on the golden band..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whose crown?""
entries.dialogueText: "Whose crown?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does that mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that all?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that all?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Please don't interrupt, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't interrupt, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The higher it journeys upward, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The higher it journeys upward, the larger the crack gets."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Whether or not it can be mended is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether or not it can be mended is uncertain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't understand."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As in it can be fixed?""
entries.dialogueText: "As in it can be fixed?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean it's uncertain?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean it's uncertain?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The visions are possible outcomes..."
entries.dialogueText: "The visions are possible outcomes of what could come to pass. They aren't set in stone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His grip tightened."
entries.dialogueText: His grip tightened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What else do you see?""
entries.dialogueText: "What else do you see?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that all?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that all?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go on.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go on."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Okay, I'm listening...""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, I'm listening..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I now see soldiers... Many soldier..."
entries.dialogueText: "I now see soldiers... Many soldiers... War... And death. So much death."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""War with whom?""
entries.dialogueText: "War with whom?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whose soldiers? Are they ours?""
entries.dialogueText: "Whose soldiers? Are they ours?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And the victor?""
entries.dialogueText: "And the victor?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I can not tell.""
entries.dialogueText: "I can not tell."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I continued to listen closely to hi..."
entries.dialogueText: I continued to listen closely to his words.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I now see two individuals... They..."
entries.dialogueText: "I now see two individuals... They are embraced in each other's arms... Lovers."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Before me now is a heart... it's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before me now is a heart... it's being stabbed by a sword."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A metaphor for betrayal?""
entries.dialogueText: "A metaphor for betrayal?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The death of a lover, perhaps?""
entries.dialogueText: "The death of a lover, perhaps?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is starting to sound like utt..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is starting to sound like utter nonsense."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Now, I behold an endless sea of pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, I behold an endless sea of people stretching as far as the eye can see... They are marching toward the royal palace... in joy or anger... I can not say for sure."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Above them are birds... tens of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Above them are birds... tens of thousands of them so thick they blacken the sky... They are migrating from distant lands and making their nest in ours..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's obvious that the birds repres..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's obvious that the birds represent Wehzek Dastnurists coming to our lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The birds clearly represent Golcon..."
entries.dialogueText: "The birds clearly represent Golcondists coming to our lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It sounds to me like they represen..."
entries.dialogueText: "It sounds to me like they represent literal birds."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""And on a nearby mountain overlooki..."
entries.dialogueText: "And on a nearby mountain overlooking the city sits a beast... a beast with three heads. Each head is fighting with the other..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""They must be brought under control..."
entries.dialogueText: "They must be brought under control, either through taming or severing one or more heads..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""...or all three will surely die.""
entries.dialogueText: "...or all three will surely die."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia's royal houses. Toras, Sazon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's royal houses. Toras, Sazon and Azaro."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As it stands, Rizian lands are rul..."
entries.dialogueText: "As it stands, Rizian lands are ruled under three different flags... Wehlen, The Grand Duchy of Pales, and our own... That could be the meaning..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alright. I've heard enough of this..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alright. I've heard enough of this bullshit. Let me go."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt Sal loosen his hold of me, l..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt Sal loosen his hold of me, letting go.

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It's not forgiveness from you that..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not forgiveness from you that you should be seeking, but forgiveness from God."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.dialogueText: "You only just inherited the throne -- an appointment that comes with the greatest of responsibilities -- so allow me to offer you some advice..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, yeah? And what's that?""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. But keep it brief.""

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""What I wanted to say was... burn t..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put on my clothes, and made my wa..."
entries.dialogueText: I put on my clothes, and made my way back through the catacombs until I'd reached the surface -- the events of today, forever burned in my memory.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why do you need my hands?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why do you need my hands?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's this about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's this about?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What are you doing?""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's going on?""

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, I haven't changed my mind abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I haven't changed my mind about that. However... perhaps we can overlook my abstention?"

entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""That's asking a lot. The importanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's asking a lot. The importance of the ceremony cannot be overstated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What if I made it worth your while?""
entries.dialogueText: "What if I made it worth your while?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What if I told you there would be..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if I told you there would be consequences for defying the king's wishes?"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Then I would tell you that repercu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I would tell you that repercussions are of no concern to me. I stand on the side of God. Can you say the same?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, Your Holiness, it seems we'v..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Your Holiness, it seems we've reached an impasse. I'll see myself out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A man with convictions... It's a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "A man with convictions... It's a rarity these days. I respect that. Until next time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well then... now that we better un..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well then... now that we better understand each other, perhaps we can one day channel that newfound knowledge toward seeing eye to eye."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Perhaps.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Divus zaitu.""
entries.dialogueText: "Divus zaitu."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Next time, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Next time, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Divus zaitu.""
entries.dialogueText: "Divus zaitu."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever you say.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. Forget what I said...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Forget what I said. 'Til next time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't say the same about you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't say the same about you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Make no mistake... In matters of u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make no mistake... In matters of upholding principles, my steadfastness knows no bounds."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""While I have my reservations about..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I have my reservations about what you're suggesting... My curiosity far outweighs my skepticism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I expect nothing less.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I expect nothing less."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Meaning?""
entries.dialogueText: "Meaning?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I look forward to future discussio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to future discussions. Maybe then I can nurture your curiosity even further."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then I look forward to speaking to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I look forward to speaking to you about future... arrangements."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We shall see.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As I with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "As I with you."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""That I may be old, but I know whic..."
entries.dialogueText: "That I may be old, but I know which way to move when the wind blows."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""I look forward to speaking more ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to speaking more about this with you at a later date."

entries.dialogueText: The tense interaction with the grand wiseman and the friction that came with it wasn't beneficial for anyone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As my motorcade journeyed down the..."
entries.dialogueText: As my motorcade journeyed down the highway and the Archsacturary of Plavo gradually disappeared from sight, I reflected on all I had achieved today.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good to hear. I underestimated you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good to hear. I underestimated you, Your Holiness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to be around someone..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to be around someone who is so easily swayed. Forget it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very good. I look forward to futur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good. I look forward to future *arrangements* between us."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Most do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Most do."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as the wind continues to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the wind continues to blow in the right direction."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes, of course. Though predicting..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, of course. Though predicting the weather can be a tricky thing."
